_about: One battle scene per operation. `accent` is the operation's ENCOUNTER accent (flat pixel B color ownership): in battle it drives the header battle count and rule and the enemy card frames and name headers, nothing else. `wall_texture`, `floor_texture`, `edge_accent` and `streak` feed the v3 perspective scene (debug F9 only). Colours are PixelUI token names, never hexes. Empty fields draw the bare scene. Operations without an entry use `fallback`. The dice tray floor (Kev, 2026-10-17, DECISIONS_RESOLVED G-79, replacing G-76's grate + ember): `tray_floor` names the entry of `tray_floors` every operation uses; a scene entry may set its own `tray_floor` to override it (none do). There is no battle backdrop image (G-76): battle and in-run screens show the plain dark background token.

reticle._about: One image at the tray's exact art size (260 x 223 art px = the 1040 x 892 design px tray / 4), built from assets/art_incoming/tray_reticle_raw.png by tools/build_tray_floor.py: a flat dark charcoal surface, a faint diagonal texture, one thin gray reticle at the centre. battle_bay_floor.gd draws it one texel per art pixel, centred on the tray; a tray of another size crops the image's edges or extends it with the image's most common colour. A missing image leaves the plain dark background.
